If at any point it becomes impossible for the listed team to finish 28th in the 2026 Liga Profesional (Argentina), the associated market will resolve to "No".

If the 2026 Liga Profesional (Argentina) season is cancelled, postponed after December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET, or there is otherwise no 28th place team declared within that timeframe, this market will resolve to "Other".

The resolution source for this market will be official information from Liga Profesional (Argentina); however, a consensus of credible reporting may also be used.
